name: @threejson/player-kit
description: Embeddable ThreeJSON scene player runtime: mount to a canvas, load/dispose scenes, transport (play/pause), highlight, editor-preview protocol, playlist IndexedDB storage. No full app shell (top bar, playlist list UI, settings modal) — that stays in tools/scene-host/player and the future apps/scene-player.
